Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

ConnectionStrings._comment_IdentityDb: Secret — supplied via ConnectionStrings__IdentityDb env var / K8s Secret, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).
ConnectionStrings._comment_Redis: Secret — supplied via ConnectionStrings__Redis env var / K8s Secret, never committed. Shared ephemeral-security-state deployment (design-decisions.md).

RabbitMq._comment: ManifestPath points at message-bus-manifest.json (copied here at build time from contracts/) — the single source of truth for this service's entire RabbitMQ topology (exchanges, queues, bindings, dead-letter/retry wiring). HostName is the only messaging setting not described by the manifest.

SigningKey._comment_PrivateKeyPem: Secret — supplied via Jwt__SigningKey__PrivateKeyPem env var / K8s Secret, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).

Encryption._comment_KeyBase64: Secret — supplied via Mfa__Encryption__KeyBase64 env var / K8s Secret, never committed. Base64-encoded 256-bit AES key (requirement-spec.md §4 PII invariant).
